The e2e/unit suites exercise the BUILT dist/*.js in spawned child processes, not src/*.ts directly. c8 currently reports ~0% because dist is (correctly) excluded from the src-oriented report and there is no dist->src sourcemap remap wired up. A threshold on a 0% measurement would be a vacuous, lying gate. Enabling a real gate requires instrumenting dist and mapping back to src via sourcemaps (tracked as a follow-up). Until then coverage is report-only and uploaded as a CI artifact.
